layers.http: src/http: request parsing and response encoding only; calls DocumentService
layers.application: src/application/document-service.ts: the single mutation entry point; owns invalidation
layers.search: src/search: query evaluation; may cache but must honor invalidate()
layers.storage: src/storage: documents, insertion sequence, mutation version
layers.domain: src/domain: contract types and text normalization

invariants.INV-NORMALIZATION: Query and text are NFC-normalized and lowercased before comparison
invariants.INV-EMPTY-QUERY: Whitespace-only query returns an empty result list
invariants.INV-SUBSTRING-MATCH: A term matches when it is a substring of normalized title + ' ' + body
invariants.INV-RESULT-ORDER: Results are in document insertion order
invariants.INV-LIMIT: Limit truncates after ordering; limit 0 returns nothing
invariants.INV-INSERT-VISIBILITY: An inserted document is searchable immediately
invariants.INV-UPDATE-VISIBILITY: After an update, old text stops matching and new text starts matching immediately
invariants.INV-DELETE-VISIBILITY: A deleted document never appears in results
invariants.STRUCT-IMPORT-BOUNDARY: src/http never imports src/storage or src/search; mutations go through DocumentService

performance.metric: median of per-repetition p95 latency (ms) after warmup, fixed workload, same schedule for baseline and candidate
performance.acceptance: correctness and learned pass, p95 improves over current best by at least the acceptance margin, and enough paired repetitions improve
